label: L=4 final copy step re-reading x (plus sparse t=3 original-token firings)
explanation: Very sparse (~0.017% of steps). About 87% of activation mass falls at two positions: step 3 (the 4th original token, ~42%) and recall_idx 3, mostly the last copy step of L=4 sequences (t=7, ~45%). Strongest single mode: L=4, t=7, input x (orig(2)=x fed back while outputting the last token). The top activations (~0.2) are here, especially when the prefix is u/s/w/p (e.g. u p x c). Even this mode has only ~17% precision: most L=4 sequences with x at position 2 do not fire, and the choice seems to depend on the earlier tokens in a way no simple predicate captures. The t=3 firings are on varied tokens (w, r, x, f, o, j, 2), enriched when a 0 appears earlier (prev2_tok=0 gives 13x lift), but precision there is only ~2%. Never fires at t=0..2, almost never past t=11, and rarely on <DEL>. Activation size is fairly flat (median 0.12, max 0.2). No coherent predicate gets past F1 ~0.23.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=x (+4.96), in_tok=d (+3.25), t=3 & prev_tok=g (+3.23), prev2_tok=0 (+3.20), t=3 & prev_tok=z (+3.13), prev3_tok=0 (+3.11). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-3.05), orig3=3 (-2.50), prev2_tok=e (-2.32), orig0=3 (-2.29).
